# @trysac/mcp-readonly-fs

> Read-only MCP filesystem server over allowlisted roots with realpath containment, deny globs on real paths, size and binary caps, and readOnlyHint tools. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage and API
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and undefended cases
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files and coverage
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records
